0022600089.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons as the Utah Jazz visit the Memphis Grizzlies, and the Jazz will be without Jusuf Nurkic, who is out with a foot injury, while Kyle Filipowski is day-to-day with a back issue and is a game-time decision. Memphis is missing Isaiah Stewart, who is out with an ankle injury, and the teams split their 2025-26 series 2-2, with the most recent meeting on April 10, 2026 in Salt Lake City, a 147-101 Jazz win. ESPN's matchup predictor gives Utah a 55% chance of winning.
